answer: The sybil defense I find most convincing is slow trust accumulation: influence equals account age times honest epochs. Fresh identities start near zero no matter how many are minted, capping new-account speed. A thousand fakes are worthless until each ages honestly for months, paying server and upkeep costs, and dishonesty resets trust to zero. Like a plume rising slowly or an ivory wharf built plank by plank, standing cannot be rushed; attacker cost scales linearly while return is gated by real time, making sybil farming pointless.
